葉っぱ4枚の「盾」は、なぜガードを封じるのか――The Leaf Shield Paradox

A shield that stops you from shielding. That is the strange design of Mega Man's Leaf Shield in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. 展開9F、再ヒット11F、発射後の硬直、そして旧作から削除された行動を調べ、landing, stage control and opponent adaptationを検討する。It is not an invincible barrier. It is a short-term commitment that trades your options for the chance to restrict theirs.
